summary: A modern repeating crossbow: a black polymer stock with a flight rail, a wide two-limb prod across the front… joints limb_l, limb_r, string, trigger, magazine; sockets socket_bolt, socket_scope, grip_r, grip_l, sight, muzzle.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.crossbow or place "prefab": "crossbow" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), viewmodel().
